_comment: SMART L1 — the narrative layer. Created 2026-09-22 (issue #975) on the owner's stack ruling: `core->fhir-harness-> smart-base->siblings{smart-l1, smart-dak, smart-ig}`. It holds the L1 assets a Digital Adaptation Kit is WRITTEN FROM — WHO guideline narrative, the recommendations and their evidence, the figures and tables a DTH cites. DECLARES NO DIRECTORIES, deliberately. That is the `folio-assistant-core` precedent, which was created declaring none because what it would own was still interleaved elsewhere: declaring a directory that is not there is the `dh4f` defect, where every consumer scans nothing and reports a CLEAN RUN over it. An instance that declares only what it has is honest; one that declares its target layout is a lie a gate cannot catch. THE CANDIDATE CONTENT IS NOT HERE YET: the WHO digital-health corpus sits in `smart-base/library/` (PR #881); GRADE, once the other candidate, became the `grade` skill and code lists in cat-harness on 2026-09-24 (bean wg7r). Whether it moves here is a judgement about what each asset IS, not a mechanical sweep, and it is not made by creating this file.
